definitions.explanation: Costing less than expected or less than alternatives. Emphasizes the result of something turning out to be affordable or low-cost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自炊|じすい}→自炊：09551_jisui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安上|やすあ}がりだ。
{安上|やすあ}がりな⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for an economical travel plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{安上|やすあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: If you make it by hand, it turns out cheaper than buying it.

notes:
Describes something that turns out to be inexpensive — emphasizes the result being cheap rather than the initial cost.

FORMS:
⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (cheap) + ⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (result/outcome). Literally "cheap outcome."
- Na-adjective: {安上|やすあ}がりな⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (an economical trip)
- Predicate: ⟦{自炊|じすい}→自炊：09551_jisui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安上|やすあ}がりだ (cooking for yourself is cheap)
- Adverb: {安上|やすあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to get off cheaply)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜より{安上|やすあ}がり: cheaper than ~

- {安上|やすあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧: to end up being inexpensive
